steps.detail: Read only: free GPU hours per cluster and per node over the last 14 days. Stop if the median is under 2 free GPUs.
PR 1, the GCP canary: Slinky charts, HelmRelease, PriorityClass gpu-training, control plane, and a login pod with /home on a new Filestore share, NodeSet at 0. It touches no GPU.

steps.step: Training pods and KEDA scaling on uss1
steps.detail: PR 2: NodeSet plus KEDA scaling. Test: run a 4 GPU job, force an inference scale-up, and confirm the worker gets its GPU within 60 s and the job requeues and resumes.
PR 3, training side: an sbatch preset with --requeue, periodic checkpoints under /home, and resume on start, saving optimizer and RNG state.

PR 4: install on use1 and usw3, shared accounting database, federation, /home mounted everywhere. Jean applies the Terraform: controller access between clusters and the Filestore export to all node subnets.
Training GPU hours served from idle B200s against RunPod and Modal spend, with inference p99 and Modal spill unchanged.
